raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
PSPO I Certified Product Owner and Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of Agile delivery across enterprise BFSI and digital SaaS platforms. Deep domain expertise across Capital Markets (Equities, ECM, Fixed Income, FX, Trade Finance), Wealth Management platforms, UPI/NPCI payment rails, AML/KYC, Regulatory Reporting, and Core Banking. Proven track record defining product roadmaps, owning prioritised backlogs, running sprint ceremonies, and shipping digital products on time and within scope. Hands- on experience with NPCI integrations, merchant onboarding, and payment system compliance for leading PSU banks. Skilled cross- functional collaborator with technology, UX, risk, compliance, and legal teams. Delivered INR 28L+ business impact across marquee banking clients including SBI, HDFC Bank, and Canara Bank.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner | Alpha Plus Technologies Pvt Ltd
Sep 2025 – Apr 2026
Acted as Product Owner for TasC+ and Compliance Kartavya+ (AML/KYC & Regulatory SaaS); owned backlog prioritisation based on business value, customer impact, compliance requirements, and delivery dependencies.
Defined product roadmap, release planning, sprint goals, and acceptance criteria; collaborated with UI/UX team on user flows, wireframes, and information architecture.
Elicited requirements from cross-functional stakeholders — Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, UX, Technology, and QA — to define critical user journeys, workflows, and data models.
Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives; conducted backlog grooming and ensured sprint readiness across delivery teams.
Managed UAT achieving 99% test coverage with near-zero production defects; defined KPIs, adoption metrics, and product performance dashboards.
Scaled product from MVP to MVP+2 in 5 months; delivered INR 28L+ business impact (Canara Bank INR 10L; HDFC Bank INR 18L).
Business Analyst / Agile Delivery Lead | Orient Technologies Ltd
Nov 2018 – Sep 2025
Led Agile delivery as de facto Product Owner across 65+ enterprise BFSI, Healthcare, and Retail clients; managed parallel delivery streams in Azure DevOps and JIRA across multiple product teams.
Capital Markets & Wealth Management: Supported backlog and sprint delivery for Equities, ECM, Fixed Income (Govt Bonds, Corporate Bonds, T-Bills, Debentures, CPs, CDs), FX, and Wealth Management platforms; translated investment and advisory business flows into structured user stories and acceptance criteria for digital trading and portfolio servicing tools.
UPI & Payments (SBI): Led requirements definition for UPI/NPCI integration and merchant onboarding for a leading PSU bank; defined P2P and P2M transaction flows, NPCI API integration specs, and merchant registration journeys; ensured adherence to NPCI guidelines and RBI payment system regulations.
AML/KYC & Regulatory: Drove backlog grooming and sprint delivery for AML transaction monitoring, KYC onboarding, and RBI/SEBI/GST reporting dashboards; performed regulatory gap assessments and ensured near-zero post-UAT defects.
Cards & Core Banking: Delivered requirements for card issuance, payment gateway integrations, reconciliation platforms, and core banking workflows; designed REST API integration layers aligned to RBI guidelines.
Collaborated with business, technology, UX, risk, cyber, fraud, legal, and compliance stakeholders to elicit and validate requirements; built Power BI/SQL dashboards for sprint health and delivery risk.
Logistics Analyst | Arvato Bertelsmann
Nov 2017 – Sep 2018
Improved delivery KPIs and operational performance by streamlining escalation processes between logistics and warehousing teams.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Product Ownership: Roadmap Definition, Backlog Management, Release Planning, Prioritisation, User Story Writing, Acceptance Criteria, MVP Delivery, KPI & Adoption Metrics Agile / Scrum: Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming, Velocity Tracking, Burn-down Reporting Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering, BRD/FRD, Use Cases, Process Flows, Data Flow Modelling, Gap Analysis, RTM, UAT, Stakeholder Management Domain – Capital Markets / BFSI: Equities, ECM, Fixed Income (Bonds, T-Bills, Debentures, CPs, CDs), FX, Wealth Management, UPI/NPCI, AML/KYC, Regulatory Reporting (RBI/SEBI/GST), Core Banking, Cards & Payments Stakeholder Management: AVP/CXO Engagement, Tech · UX · Risk · Compliance · Legal · Cyber Collaboration, User Demos, Status Presentations Tools & Technical: Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, Power BI, SQL, REST APIs, Swagger/Postman, MS Dynamics 365, ServiceNow
2026–2028
B.E. – Electronics & Telecommunication | Mumbai University — Lokmanya Tilak College of Engineering 
2017
